summary: Monero is +6.5% in 24h and was one of only two large coins up on the week. No dated news: overnight X volume is inflated by copy-paste 'vote for $Monero on CoinMarketCap' spam tied to an unrelated token contract, so raw counts overstate interest; the 24h total is about 0.84x the 3-day norm. FCMP upgrade talk is ongoing, with no release date. Neutral.
